_readme: Data for index.html (Control Room). Edit values here, not in the HTML. Update asOf on every change. Confidence letters follow the A-E taxonomy. Outcome-tape weights are editorial judgment (confidence E): any tool may propose changes, and each event should cite its ledger entry.

gauges.title: Oracle: rating vs. market
gauges.note: Agencies hold investment grade (S&P BBB- stable; Moody's Baa2 negative). The CDS market prices Oracle near the single-B index.

gauges.title: Hormuz chokepoint
gauges.note: UKMTO counted 263 transits in the week to 18 Nov, ~65% below pre-war. AIS-visible counts are far lower (2 on 15 Nov).
gauges.source: B · UKMTO, IMF PortWatch, Straits Live

gauges.title: Capex vs. operating cash
gauges.note: Quarterly capex above 100% of operating cash flow means negative free cash flow. Alphabet: −$5.9B Q2, −$9.1B Q3.

gauges.title: BCRED redemption gate
gauges.note: About half of requested capital paid each quarter. Signature weight stays low unless the gate lasts a third quarter or the backlog grows.
gauges.source: A · BCRED 8-K/10-Q · Q4 data early Dec
